passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.1
passages.text: Omnes quidem libelli mei, domine, quibus tu fa-

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.2
passages.text: mam, id est vitam, dedisti, tibi supplicant; et, puto,

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.3
passages.text: propter hoc legentur. Hic tamen, qui operis nostri octa-

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.4
passages.text: vus inscribitur, occasione pietatis frequentius fruitur.

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.5
passages.text: Minus itaque ingenio laborandum fuit, in cuius locum

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.6
passages.text: materia successerat: quam quidem subinde aliqua ioco-

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.7
passages.text: rum mixtura variare temptavimus, ne caelesti verecun-

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.8
passages.text: diae tuae laudes suas, quae facilius te fatigare possint,

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.9
passages.text: quam nos satiare, omnis versus ingereret. Quamvis

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.10
passages.text: autem epigrammata a severissimis quoque et summae

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.11
passages.text: fortunae viris ita scripta sint, ut mimicam verborum

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.12
passages.text: licentiam adfectasse videantur, ego tamen illis non per-

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.13
passages.text: misi tam lascive loqui quam solent. Cum pars libri et

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.14
passages.text: maior et melior ad maiestatem sacri nominis tui alli-

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.15
passages.text: gata sit, meminerit non nisi religiosa purificatione

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.16
passages.text: lustratos accedere ad templa debere. Quod ut custo-

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.17
passages.text: diturum me lecturi sciant, in ipso libelli huius limine

passages.label: Mart. 8.pr.18
passages.text: profiteri brevissimo placuit epigrammate.

passages.label: Mart. 8.1.1
passages.text: Laurigeros domini, liber, intrature penates

passages.label: Mart. 8.1.2
passages.text: Disce verecundo sanctius ore loqui.

passages.label: Mart. 8.1.3
passages.text: Nuda recede Venus; non est tuus iste libellus:

passages.label: Mart. 8.1.4
passages.text: Tu mihi, tu Pallas Caesariana, veni.

passages.label: Mart. 8.2.1
passages.text: Fastorum genitor parensque Ianus

passages.label: Mart. 8.2.2
passages.text: Victorem modo cum videret Histri,

passages.label: Mart. 8.2.3
passages.text: Tot vultus sibi non satis putavit

passages.label: Mart. 8.2.4
passages.text: Optavitque oculos habere plures:

passages.label: Mart. 8.2.5
passages.text: Et lingua pariter locutus omni

passages.label: Mart. 8.2.6
passages.text: Terrarum domino deoque rerum

passages.label: Mart. 8.2.7
passages.text: Promisit Pyliam quater senectam.

passages.label: Mart. 8.2.8
passages.text: Addas, Iane pater, tuam rogamus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.1
passages.text: 'Quinque satis fuerant: nam sex septemve libelli

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.2
passages.text: Est nimium: quid adhuc ludere, Musa, iuvat?

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.3
passages.text: Sit pudor et finis: iam plus nihil addere nobis

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.4
passages.text: Fama potest: teritur noster ubique liber;

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.5
passages.text: Et cum rupta situ Messalae saxa iacebunt

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.6
passages.text: Altaque cum Licini marmora pulvis erunt,

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.7
passages.text: Me tamen ora legent et secum plurimus hospes

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.8
passages.text: Ad patrias sedes carmina nostra feret.'

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.9
passages.text: Finieram, cum sic respondit nona sororum,

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.10
passages.text: Cui coma et unguento sordida vestis erat:

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.11
passages.text: 'Tune potes dulcis, ingrate, relinquere nugas?

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.12
passages.text: Dic mihi, quid melius desidiosus ages?

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.13
passages.text: An iuvat ad tragicos soccum transferre coturnos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.14
passages.text: Aspera vel paribus bella tonare modis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.15
passages.text: Praelegat ut tumidus rauca te voce magister

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.16
passages.text: Oderit et grandis virgo bonusque puer?

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.17
passages.text: Scribant ista graves nimium nimiumque severi,

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.18
passages.text: Quos media miseros nocte lucerna videt.

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.19
passages.text: At tu Romano lepidos sale tinge libellos:

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.20
passages.text: Agnoscat mores vita legatque suos.

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.21
passages.text: Angusta cantare licet videaris avena,

passages.label: Mart. 8.3.22
passages.text: Dum tua multorum vincat avena tubas.'

passages.label: Mart. 8.4.1
passages.text: Quantus, io, Latias mundi conventus ad aras

passages.label: Mart. 8.4.2
passages.text: Suscipit et solvit pro duce vota suo!

passages.label: Mart. 8.4.3
passages.text: Non sunt haec hominum, Germanice, gaudia tantum,

passages.label: Mart. 8.4.4
passages.text: Sed faciunt ipsi nunc, puto, sacra dei.

passages.label: Mart. 8.5.1
passages.text: Dum donas, Macer, anulos puellis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.5.2
passages.text: Desisti, Macer, anulos habere.

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.1
passages.text: Archetypis vetuli nihil est odiosius Eucti

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.2
passages.text: —Ficta Saguntino cymbia malo luto—,

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.3
passages.text: Argenti furiosa sui cum stemmata narrat

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.4
passages.text: Garrulus et verbis mucida vina facit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.5
passages.text: 'Laomedonteae fuerant haec pocula mensae:

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.6
passages.text: Ferret ut haec, muros struxit Apollo lyra.

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.7
passages.text: Hoc cratere ferox commisit proelia Rhoetus

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.8
passages.text: Cum Lapithis: pugna debile cernis opus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.9
passages.text: Hi duo longaevo censentur Nestore fundi:

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.10
passages.text: Pollice de Pylio trita columba nitet.

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.11
passages.text: Hic scyphus est, in quo misceri iussit amicis

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.12
passages.text: Largius Aeacides vividiusque merum.

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.13
passages.text: Hac propinavit Bitiae pulcherrima Dido

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.14
passages.text: In patera, Phrygio cum data cena viro est.'

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.15
passages.text: Miratus fueris cum prisca toreumata multum,

passages.label: Mart. 8.6.16
passages.text: In Priami calathis Astyanacta bibes.

passages.label: Mart. 8.7.1
passages.text: Hoc agere est causas, hoc dicere, Cinna, diserte,

passages.label: Mart. 8.7.2
passages.text: Horis, Cinna, decem dicere verba novem?

passages.label: Mart. 8.7.3
passages.text: Sed modo clepsydras ingenti voce petisti

passages.label: Mart. 8.7.4
passages.text: Quattuor. O quantum, Cinna, tacere potes!

passages.label: Mart. 8.8.1
passages.text: Principium des, Iane, licet velocibus annis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.8.2
passages.text: Et renoves voltu saecula longa tuo,

passages.label: Mart. 8.8.3
passages.text: Te primum pia tura rogent, te vota salutent,

passages.label: Mart. 8.8.4
passages.text: Purpura te felix, te colat omnis honos:

passages.label: Mart. 8.8.5
passages.text: Tu tamen hoc mavis, Latiae quod contigit urbi

passages.label: Mart. 8.8.6
passages.text: Mense tuo reducem, Iane, videre deum.

passages.label: Mart. 8.9.1
passages.text: Solvere dodrantem nuper tibi, Quinte, volebat

passages.label: Mart. 8.9.2
passages.text: Lippus Hylas, luscus vult dare dimidium.

passages.label: Mart. 8.9.3
passages.text: Accipe quam primum; brevis est occasio lucri:

passages.label: Mart. 8.9.4
passages.text: Si fuerit caecus, nil tibi solvet Hylas.

passages.label: Mart. 8.10.1
passages.text: Emit lacernas milibus decem Bassus

passages.label: Mart. 8.10.2
passages.text: Tyrias coloris optimi. Lucri fecit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.10.3
passages.text: 'Adeo bene emit?' inquis. Immo non solvet.

passages.label: Mart. 8.11.1
passages.text: Pervenisse tuam iam te scit Rhenus in urbem;

passages.label: Mart. 8.11.2
passages.text: Nam populi voces audit et ille tui:

passages.label: Mart. 8.11.3
passages.text: Sarmaticas etiam gentes Histrumque Getasque

passages.label: Mart. 8.11.4
passages.text: Laetitiae clamor terruit ipse novae.

passages.label: Mart. 8.11.5
passages.text: Dum te longa sacro venerantur gaudia Circo,

passages.label: Mart. 8.11.6
passages.text: Nemo quater missos currere sensit equos.

passages.label: Mart. 8.11.7
passages.text: Nullum Roma ducem, nec te sic, Caesar, amavit:

passages.label: Mart. 8.11.8
passages.text: Te quoque iam non plus, ut velit ipsa, potest.

passages.label: Mart. 8.12.1
passages.text: Uxorem quare locupletem ducere nolim,

passages.label: Mart. 8.12.2
passages.text: Quaeritis? Uxori nubere nolo meae.

passages.label: Mart. 8.12.3
passages.text: Inferior matrona suo sit, Prisce, marito:

passages.label: Mart. 8.12.4
passages.text: Non aliter fiunt femina virque pares.

passages.label: Mart. 8.13.1
passages.text: Morio dictus erat: viginti milibus emi.

passages.label: Mart. 8.13.2
passages.text: Redde mihi nummos, Gargiliane: sapit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.14.1
passages.text: Pallida ne Cilicum timeant pomaria brumam

passages.label: Mart. 8.14.2
passages.text: Mordeat et tenerum fortior aura nemus,

passages.label: Mart. 8.14.3
passages.text: Hibernis obiecta notis specularia puros

passages.label: Mart. 8.14.4
passages.text: Admittunt soles et sine faece diem.

passages.label: Mart. 8.14.5
passages.text: At mihi cella datur, non tota clusa fenestra,

passages.label: Mart. 8.14.6
passages.text: In qua nec Boreas ipse manere velit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.14.7
passages.text: Sic habitare iubes veterem crudelis amicum

passages.label: Mart. 8.14.8
passages.text: Arboris ergo tuae tutior hospes ero.

passages.label: Mart. 8.15.1
passages.text: Dum nova Pannonici numeratur gloria belli,

passages.label: Mart. 8.15.2
passages.text: Omnis et ad reducem dum litat ara Iovem,

passages.label: Mart. 8.15.3
passages.text: Dat populus, dat gratus eques, dat tura senatus,

passages.label: Mart. 8.15.4
passages.text: Et ditant Latias tertia dona tribus:

passages.label: Mart. 8.15.5
passages.text: Hos quoque secretos memoravit Roma triumphos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.15.6
passages.text: Nec minor ista tuae laurea pacis erat,

passages.label: Mart. 8.15.7
passages.text: Quod tibi de sancta credis pietate tuorum.

passages.label: Mart. 8.15.8
passages.text: Principis est virtus maxima, nosse suos.

passages.label: Mart. 8.16.1
passages.text: Pistor qui fueras diu, Cypere,

passages.label: Mart. 8.16.2
passages.text: Causas nunc agis et ducena quaeris:

passages.label: Mart. 8.16.3
passages.text: Sed consumis et usque mutuaris.

passages.label: Mart. 8.16.4
passages.text: A pistore, Cypere, non recedis:

passages.label: Mart. 8.16.5
passages.text: Et panem facis et facis farinam.

passages.label: Mart. 8.17.1
passages.text: Egi, Sexte, tuam, pactus duo milia, causam:

passages.label: Mart. 8.17.2
passages.text: Misisti nummos quod mihi mille, quid est?

passages.label: Mart. 8.17.3
passages.text: 'Narrasti nihil' inquis 'et a te perdita causa est.'

passages.label: Mart. 8.17.4
passages.text: Tanto plus debes, Sexte, quod erubui.

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.1
passages.text: Si tua, Cerrini, promas epigrammata vulgo,

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.2
passages.text: Vel mecum possis vel prior ipse legi:

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.3
passages.text: Sed tibi tantus inest veteris respectus amici,

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.4
passages.text: Carior ut mea sit quam tua fama tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.5
passages.text: Sic Maro nec Calabri temptavit carmina Flacci,

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.6
passages.text: Pindaricos nosset cum superare modos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.7
passages.text: Et Vario cessit Romani laude coturni,

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.8
passages.text: Cum posset tragico fortius ore loqui.

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.9
passages.text: Aurum et opes et rura frequens donabit amicus:

passages.label: Mart. 8.18.10
passages.text: Qui velit ingenio cedere, rarus erit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.19.1
passages.text: Pauper videri Cinna vult; et est pauper.

passages.label: Mart. 8.20.1
passages.text: Cum facias versus nulla non luce ducenos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.20.2
passages.text: Vare, nihil recitas. Non sapis, atque sapis.

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.1
passages.text: Phosphore, redde diem: quid gaudia nostra moraris?

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.2
passages.text: Caesare venturo, Phosphore, redde diem.

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.3
passages.text: Roma rogat. Placidi numquid te pigra Bootae

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.4
passages.text: Plaustra vehunt, lento quod nimis axe venis?

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.5
passages.text: Ledaeo poteras abducere Cyllaron astro:

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.6
passages.text: Ipse suo cedet nunc tibi Castor equo.

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.7
passages.text: Quid cupidum Titana tenes? Iam Xanthus et Aethon

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.8
passages.text: Frena volunt, vigilat Memnonis alma parens.

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.9
passages.text: Tarda tamen nitidae non cedunt sidera luci,

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.10
passages.text: Et cupit Ausonium luna videre ducem.

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.11
passages.text: Iam, Caesar, vel nocte veni: stent astra licebit,

passages.label: Mart. 8.21.12
passages.text: Non deerit populo te veniente dies.

passages.label: Mart. 8.22.1
passages.text: Invitas ad aprum, ponis mihi, Gallice, porcum.

passages.label: Mart. 8.22.2
passages.text: Hybrida sum, si das, Gallice, verba mihi.

passages.label: Mart. 8.23.1
passages.text: Esse tibi videor saevus nimiumque gulosus,

passages.label: Mart. 8.23.2
passages.text: Qui propter cenam, Rustice, caedo cocum.

passages.label: Mart. 8.23.3
passages.text: Si levis ista tibi flagrorum causa videtur,

passages.label: Mart. 8.23.4
passages.text: Ex qua vis causa vapulet ergo cocus?

passages.label: Mart. 8.24.1
passages.text: Si quid forte petam timido gracilique libello,

passages.label: Mart. 8.24.2
passages.text: Inproba non fuerit si mea charta, dato.

passages.label: Mart. 8.24.3
passages.text: Et si non dederis, Caesar, permitte rogari:

passages.label: Mart. 8.24.4
passages.text: Offendunt numquam tura precesque Iovem.

passages.label: Mart. 8.24.5
passages.text: Qui fingit sacros auro vel marmore vultus,

passages.label: Mart. 8.24.6
passages.text: Non facit ille deos: qui rogat, ille facit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.25.1
passages.text: Vidisti semel, Oppiane, tantum

passages.label: Mart. 8.25.2
passages.text: Aegrum me, male, saepe te videbo.

passages.label: Mart. 8.26.1
passages.text: Non tot in Eois timuit Gangeticus arvis

passages.label: Mart. 8.26.2
passages.text: Raptor, in Hyrcano qui fugit albus equo,

passages.label: Mart. 8.26.3
passages.text: Quot tua Roma novas vidit, Germanice, tigres:

passages.label: Mart. 8.26.4
passages.text: Delicias potuit nec numerare suas.

passages.label: Mart. 8.26.5
passages.text: Vincit Erythraeos tua, Caesar, harena triumphos

passages.label: Mart. 8.26.6
passages.text: Et victoris opes divitiasque dei:

passages.label: Mart. 8.26.7
passages.text: Nam cum captivos ageret sub curribus Indos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.26.8
passages.text: Contentus gemina tigride Bacchus erat.

passages.label: Mart. 8.27.1
passages.text: Munera qui tibi dat locupleti, Gaure, senique,

passages.label: Mart. 8.27.2
passages.text: Si sapis et sentis, hoc tibi ait 'Morere.'

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.1
passages.text: Dic, toga, facundi gratum mihi munus amici,

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.2
passages.text: Esse velis cuius fama decusque gregis?

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.3
passages.text: Apula Ledaei tibi floruit herba Phalanthi,

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.4
passages.text: Qua saturat Calabris culta Galaesus aquis?

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.5
passages.text: An Tartesiacus stabuli nutritor Hiberi

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.6
passages.text: Baetis in Hesperia te quoque lavit ove?

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.7
passages.text: An tua multifidum numeravit lana Timavum,

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.8
passages.text: Quem pius astrifero Cyllarus ore bibit?

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.9
passages.text: Te nec Amyclaeo decuit livere veneno,

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.10
passages.text: Nec Miletos erat vellere digna tuo.

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.11
passages.text: Lilia tu vincis nec adhuc delapsa ligustra,

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.12
passages.text: Et Tiburtino monte quod alget ebur;

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.13
passages.text: Spartanus tibi cedet olor Paphiaeque columbae,

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.14
passages.text: Cedet Erythraeis eruta gemma vadis:

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.15
passages.text: Sed licet haec primis nivibus sint aemula dona,

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.16
passages.text: Non sunt Parthenio candidiora suo.

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.17
passages.text: Non ego praetulerim Babylonos picta superbae

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.18
passages.text: Texta, Samiramia quae variantur acu;

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.19
passages.text: Non Athamanteo potius me mirer in auro,

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.20
passages.text: Aeolium dones si mihi, Phrixe, pecus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.21
passages.text: O quantos risus pariter spectata movebit

passages.label: Mart. 8.28.22
passages.text: Cum Palatina nostra lacerna toga!

passages.label: Mart. 8.29.1
passages.text: Disticha qui scribit, puto, vult brevitate placere.

passages.label: Mart. 8.29.2
passages.text: Quid prodest brevitas, dic mihi, si liber est?

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.1
passages.text: Qui nunc Caesareae lusus spectatur harenae,

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.2
passages.text: Temporibus Bruti gloria summa fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.3
passages.text: Aspicis, ut teneat flammas poenaque fruatur

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.4
passages.text: Fortis et attonito regnet in igne manus!

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.5
passages.text: Ipse sui spectator adest et nobile dextrae

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.6
passages.text: Funus amat: totis pascitur illa sacris;

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.7
passages.text: Quod nisi rapta foret nolenti poena, parabat

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.8
passages.text: Saevior in lassos ire sinistra focos.

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.9
passages.text: Scire piget post tale decus, quid fecerit ante:

passages.label: Mart. 8.30.10
passages.text: Quam vidi, satis hanc est mihi nosse manum.

passages.label: Mart. 8.31.1
passages.text: Nescio quid de te non belle, Dento, fateris,

passages.label: Mart. 8.31.2
passages.text: Coniuge qui ducta iura paterna petis.

passages.label: Mart. 8.31.3
passages.text: Sed iam supplicibus dominum lassare libellis

passages.label: Mart. 8.31.4
passages.text: Desine et in patriam serus ab urbe redi:

passages.label: Mart. 8.31.5
passages.text: Nam dum tu longe deserta uxore diuque

passages.label: Mart. 8.31.6
passages.text: Tres quaeris natos, quattuor invenies.

passages.label: Mart. 8.32.1
passages.text: Ae+ra per tacitum delapsa sedentis in ipsos

passages.label: Mart. 8.32.2
passages.text: Fluxit Aretullae blanda columba sinus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.32.3
passages.text: Luserat hoc casus, nisi inobservata maneret

passages.label: Mart. 8.32.4
passages.text: Permissaque sibi nollet abire fuga.

passages.label: Mart. 8.32.5
passages.text: Si meliora piae fas est sperare sorori

passages.label: Mart. 8.32.6
passages.text: Et dominum mundi flectere vota valent,

passages.label: Mart. 8.32.7
passages.text: Haec a Sardois tibi forsitan exulis oris,

passages.label: Mart. 8.32.8
passages.text: Fratre reversuro, nuntia venit avis.

passages.label: Mart. 8.33.1
passages.text: De praetoricia folium mihi, Paule, corona

passages.label: Mart. 8.33.2

passages.text: Ne contemne caput, nihil est furacius illo;

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.4
passages.text: Non fuit Autolyci tam piperata manus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.5
passages.text: Hunc tu convivam cautus servare memento:

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.6
passages.text: Tunc furit atque oculo luscus utroque videt:

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.7
passages.text: Pocula solliciti perdunt ligulasque ministri

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.8
passages.text: Et latet in tepido plurima mappa sinu;

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.9
passages.text: Lapsa nec a cubito subducere pallia nescit

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.10
passages.text: Et tectus laenis saepe duabus abit;

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.11
passages.text: Nec dormitantem vernam fraudare lucerna

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.12
passages.text: Erubuit fallax, ardeat illa licet.

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.13
passages.text: Si nihil invasit, puerum tunc arte dolosa

passages.label: Mart. 8.59.14
passages.text: Circuit et soleas subripit ipse suas.

passages.label: Mart. 8.60.1
passages.text: Summa Palatini poteras aequare colossi,

passages.label: Mart. 8.60.2
passages.text: Si fieres brevior, Claudia, sesquipede.

passages.label: Mart. 8.61.1
passages.text: Livet Charinus, rumpitur, furit, plorat

passages.label: Mart. 8.61.2
passages.text: Et quaerit altos, unde pendeat, ramos:

passages.label: Mart. 8.61.3
passages.text: Non iam quod orbe cantor et legor toto,

passages.label: Mart. 8.61.4
passages.text: Nec umbilicis quod decorus et cedro

passages.label: Mart. 8.61.5
passages.text: Spargor per omnes Roma quas tenet gentes:

passages.label: Mart. 8.61.6
passages.text: Sed quod sub urbe rus habemus aestivum

passages.label: Mart. 8.61.7
passages.text: Vehimurque mulis non, ut ante, conductis.

passages.label: Mart. 8.61.8
passages.text: Quid inprecabor, o Severe, liventi?

passages.label: Mart. 8.61.9
passages.text: Hoc opto: mulas habeat et suburbanum.

passages.label: Mart. 8.62.1
passages.text: Scribit in aversa Picens epigrammata charta,

passages.label: Mart. 8.62.2
passages.text: Et dolet, averso quod facit illa deo.

passages.label: Mart. 8.63.1
passages.text: Thestylon Aulus amat, sed nec minus ardet Alexin,

passages.label: Mart. 8.63.2
passages.text: Forsitan et nostrum nunc Hyacinthon amat.

passages.label: Mart. 8.63.3
passages.text: I nunc et dubita, vates an diligat ipsos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.63.4
passages.text: Delicias vatum cum meus Aulus amet.

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.1
passages.text: Ut poscas, Clyte, munus exigasque,

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.2
passages.text: Uno nasceris octiens in anno

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.3
passages.text: Et solas, puto, tresve quattuorve

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.4
passages.text: Non natalicias habes Kalendas.

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.5
passages.text: Sit vultus tibi levior licebit

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.6
passages.text: Tritis litoris aridi lapillis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.7
passages.text: Sit moro coma nigrior caduco,

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.8
passages.text: Vincas mollitia tremente plumas

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.9
passages.text: Aut massam modo lactis alligati,

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.10
passages.text: Et talis tumor excitet papillas,

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.11
passages.text: Qualis cruda viro puella servat,

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.12
passages.text: Tu nobis, Clyte, iam senex videris:

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.13
passages.text: Tam multos quis enim fuisse credat

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.14
passages.text: Natalis Priamive Nestorisve?

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.15
passages.text: Sit tandem pudor et modus rapinis.

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.16
passages.text: Quod si ludis adhuc semelque nasci

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.17
passages.text: Uno iam tibi non sat est in anno,

passages.label: Mart. 8.64.18
passages.text: Natum te, Clyte, nec semel putabo.

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.1
passages.text: Hic ubi Fortunae Reducis fulgentia late

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.2
passages.text: Templa nitent, felix area nuper erat:

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.3
passages.text: Hic stetit Arctoi formosus pulvere belli

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.4
passages.text: Purpureum fundens Caesar ab ore iubar;

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.5
passages.text: Hic lauru redimita comas et candida cultu

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.6
passages.text: Roma salutavit voce manuque ducem.

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.7
passages.text: Grande loci meritum testantur et altera dona:

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.8
passages.text: Stat sacer et domitis gentibus arcus ovat;

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.9
passages.text: Hic gemini currus numerant elephanta frequentem,

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.10
passages.text: Sufficit inmensis aureus ipse iugis.

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.11
passages.text: Haec est digna tuis, Germanice, porta triumphis;

passages.label: Mart. 8.65.12
passages.text: Hos aditus urbem Martis habere decet.

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.1
passages.text: Augusto pia tura victimasque

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.2
passages.text: Pro vestro date Silio, Camenae.

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.3
passages.text: Bis senos iubet en redire fasces,

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.4
passages.text: Nato consule, nobilique virga

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.5
passages.text: Vatis Castaliam domum sonare

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.6
passages.text: Rerum prima salus et una Caesar.

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.7
passages.text: Gaudenti superest adhuc, quod optet,

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.8
passages.text: Felix purpura tertiusque consul.

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.9
passages.text: Pompeio dederit licet senatus

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.10
passages.text: Et Caesar genero sacros honores,

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.11
passages.text: Quorum pacificus ter ampliavit

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.12
passages.text: Ianus nomina: Silius frequentes

passages.label: Mart. 8.66.13
passages.text: Mavult sic numerare consulatus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.1
passages.text: Horas quinque puer nondum tibi nuntiat, et tu

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.2
passages.text: Iam conviva mihi, Caeciliane, venis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.3
passages.text: Cum modo distulerint raucae vadimonia quartae

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.4
passages.text: Et Floralicias lasset harena feras.

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.5
passages.text: Curre, age, et inlotos revoca, Calliste, ministros;

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.6
passages.text: Sternantur lecti: Caeciliane, sede.

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.7
passages.text: Caldam poscis aquam: nondum mihi frigida venit;

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.8
passages.text: Alget adhuc nudo clusa culina foco.

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.9
passages.text: Mane veni potius; nam cur te quinta moretur?

passages.label: Mart. 8.67.10
passages.text: Ut iantes, sero, Caeciliane, venis.

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.1
passages.text: Qui Corcyraei vidit pomaria regis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.2
passages.text: Rus, Entelle, tuae praeferet ille domus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.3
passages.text: Invida purpureos urat ne bruma racemos

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.4
passages.text: Et gelidum Bacchi munera frigus edat,

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.5
passages.text: Condita perspicua vivit vindemia gemma,

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.6
passages.text: Et tegitur felix nec tamen uva latet:

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.7
passages.text: Femineum lucet sic per bombycina corpus,

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.8
passages.text: Calculus in nitida sic numeratur aqua.

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.9
passages.text: Quid non ingenio voluit natura licere?

passages.label: Mart. 8.68.10
passages.text: Autumnum sterilis ferre iubetur hiems.

passages.label: Mart. 8.69.1
passages.text: Miraris veteres, Vacerra, solos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.69.2
passages.text: Nec laudas nisi mortuos poetas.

passages.label: Mart. 8.69.3
passages.text: Ignoscas petimus, Vacerra: tanti

passages.label: Mart. 8.69.4
passages.text: Non est, ut placeam tibi, perire.

passages.label: Mart. 8.70.1
passages.text: Quanta quies placidi, tantast facundia Nervae,

passages.label: Mart. 8.70.2
passages.text: Sed cohibet vires ingeniumque pudor.

passages.label: Mart. 8.70.3
passages.text: Cum siccare sacram largo Permessida posset

passages.label: Mart. 8.70.4
passages.text: Ore, verecundam maluit esse sitim,

passages.label: Mart. 8.70.5
passages.text: Pieriam tenui frontem redimire corona

passages.label: Mart. 8.70.6
passages.text: Contentus, famae nec dare vela suae.

passages.label: Mart. 8.70.7
passages.text: Sed tamen hunc nostri scit temporis esse Tibullum,

passages.label: Mart. 8.70.8
passages.text: Carmina qui docti nota Neronis habet.

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.1
passages.text: Quattuor argenti libras mihi tempore brumae

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.2
passages.text: Misisti ante annos, Postumiane, decem,

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.3
passages.text: Speranti plures—nam stare aut crescere debent

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.4
passages.text: Munera—venerunt plusve minusve duae;

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.5
passages.text: Tertius et quartus multo inferiora tulerunt;

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.6
passages.text: Libra fuit quinto Septiciana quidem;

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.7
passages.text: Besalem ad scutulam sexto pervenimus anno;

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.8
passages.text: Post hunc in cotula rasa selibra data est;

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.9
passages.text: Octavus ligulam misit sextante minorem;

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.10
passages.text: Nonus acu levius vix cocleare tulit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.11
passages.text: Quod mittat nobis decumus iam non habet annus:

passages.label: Mart. 8.71.12
passages.text: Quattuor ad libras, Postumiane, redi.

passages.label: Mart. 8.72.1
passages.text: Nondum murice cultus asperoque

passages.label: Mart. 8.72.2
passages.text: Morsu pumicis aridi politus

passages.label: Mart. 8.72.3
passages.text: Arcanum properas sequi, libelle.

passages.label: Mart. 8.72.4
passages.text: Quem pulcherrima iam redire Narbo,

passages.label: Mart. 8.72.5
passages.text: Docti Narbo Paterna Votieni,

passages.label: Mart. 8.72.6
passages.text: Ad leges iubet annuosque fasces:

passages.label: Mart. 8.72.7
passages.text: Votis quod paribus tibi petendum est,

passages.label: Mart. 8.72.8
passages.text: Continget locus ille et hic amicus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.72.9
passages.text: Quam vellem fieri meus libellus!

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.1
passages.text: Instanti, quo nec sincerior alter habetur

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.2
passages.text: Pectore nec nivea simplicitate prior,

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.3
passages.text: Si dare vis nostrae vires animosque Thaliae

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.4
passages.text: Et victura petis carmina, da quod amem.

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.5
passages.text: Cynthia te vatem fecit, lascive Properti;

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.6
passages.text: Ingenium Galli pulchra Lycoris erat;

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.7
passages.text: Fama est arguti Nemesis formosa Tibulli;

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.8
passages.text: Lesbia dictavit, docte Catulle, tibi:

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.9
passages.text: Non me Paeligni nec spernet Mantua vatem,

passages.label: Mart. 8.73.10
passages.text: Si qua Corinna mihi, si quis Alexis erit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.74.1
passages.text: Oplomachus nunc es, fueras opthalmicus ante.

passages.label: Mart. 8.74.2
passages.text: Fecisti medicus quod facis oplomachus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.1
passages.text: Dum repetit sera conductos nocte penates

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.2
passages.text: Lingonus a Tecta Flaminiaque recens,

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.3
passages.text: Expulit offenso vitiatum pollice talum

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.4
passages.text: Et iacuit toto corpore fusus humi.

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.5
passages.text: Quid faceret Gallus, qua se ratione moveret?

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.6
passages.text: Ingenti domino servulus unus erat,

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.7
passages.text: Tam macer, ut minimam posset vix ferre lucernam:

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.8
passages.text: Succurrit misero casus opemque tulit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.9
passages.text: Quattuor inscripti portabant vile cadaver,

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.10
passages.text: Accipit infelix qualia mille rogus;

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.11
passages.text: Hos comes invalidus summissa voce precatur,

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.12
passages.text: Ut quocumque velint, corpus inane ferant:

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.13
passages.text: Permutatur onus stipataque tollitur alte

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.14
passages.text: Grandis in angusta sarcina sandapila.

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.15
passages.text: Hic mihi de multis unus, Lucane, videtur,

passages.label: Mart. 8.75.16
passages.text: Cui merito dici 'mortue Galle' potest.

passages.label: Mart. 8.76.1
passages.text: 'Dic verum mihi, Marce, dic amabo;

passages.label: Mart. 8.76.2
passages.text: Nil est, quod magis audiam libenter.'

passages.label: Mart. 8.76.3
passages.text: Sic et cum recitas tuos libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.76.4
passages.text: Et causam quotiens agis clientis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.76.5
passages.text: Oras, Gallice, me rogasque semper.

passages.label: Mart. 8.76.6
passages.text: Durum est me tibi, quod petis, negare.

passages.label: Mart. 8.76.7
passages.text: Vero verius ergo quid sit, audi:

passages.label: Mart. 8.76.8
passages.text: Verum, Gallice, non libenter audis.

passages.label: Mart. 8.77.1
passages.text: Liber, amicorum dulcissima cura tuorum,

passages.label: Mart. 8.77.2
passages.text: Liber, in aeterna vivere digne rosa,

passages.label: Mart. 8.77.3
passages.text: Si sapis, Assyrio semper tibi crinis amomo

passages.label: Mart. 8.77.4
passages.text: Splendeat et cingant florea serta caput;

passages.label: Mart. 8.77.5
passages.text: Candida nigrescant vetulo crystalla Falerno

passages.label: Mart. 8.77.6
passages.text: Et caleat blando mollis amore torus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.77.7
passages.text: Qui sic vel medio finitus vixit in aevo,

passages.label: Mart. 8.77.8
passages.text: Longior huic facta est, quam data vita fuit.

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.1
passages.text: Quos cuperet Phlegraea suos victoria ludos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.2
passages.text: Indica quos cuperet pompa, Lyaee, tuos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.3
passages.text: Fecit Hyperborei celebrator Stella triumphi,

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.4
passages.text: O pudor! o pietas! et putat esse parum.

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.5
passages.text: Non illi satis est turbato sordidus auro

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.6
passages.text: Hermus et Hesperio qui sonat orbe Tagus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.7
passages.text: Omnis habet sua dona dies: nec linea dives

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.8
passages.text: Cessat, et in populum multa rapina cadit;

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.9
passages.text: Nunc veniunt subitis lasciva nomismata nimbis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.10
passages.text: Nunc dat spectatas tessera larga feras,

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.11
passages.text: Nunc implere sinus securos gaudet et absens

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.12
passages.text: Sortitur dominos, ne laceretur, avis.

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.13
passages.text: Quid numerem currus ter denaque praemia palmae,

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.14
passages.text: Quae dare non semper consul uterque solet?

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.15
passages.text: Omnia sed, Caesar, tanto superantur honore,

passages.label: Mart. 8.78.16
passages.text: Quod spectatorem te tua laurus habet.

passages.label: Mart. 8.79.1
passages.text: Omnes aut vetulas habes amicas

passages.label: Mart. 8.79.2
passages.text: Aut turpes vetulisque foediores.

passages.label: Mart. 8.79.3
passages.text: Has ducis comites trahisque tecum

passages.label: Mart. 8.79.4
passages.text: Per convivia, porticus, theatra.

passages.label: Mart. 8.79.5
passages.text: Sic formosa, Fabulla, sic puella es.

passages.label: Mart. 8.80.1
passages.text: Sanctorum nobis miracula reddis avorum

passages.label: Mart. 8.80.2
passages.text: Nec pateris, Caesar, saecula cana mori,

passages.label: Mart. 8.80.3
passages.text: Cum veteres Latiae ritus renovantur harenae

passages.label: Mart. 8.80.4
passages.text: Et pugnat virtus simpliciore manu.

passages.label: Mart. 8.80.5
passages.text: Sic priscis servatur honos te praeside templis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.80.6
passages.text: Et casa tam culto sub Iove numen habet;

passages.label: Mart. 8.80.7
passages.text: Sic nova dum condis, revocas, Auguste, priora

passages.label: Mart. 8.80.8
passages.text: Debentur quae sunt quaeque fuere tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.1
passages.text: Non per mystica sacra Dindymenes,

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.2
passages.text: Nec per Niliacae bovem iuvencae,

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.3
passages.text: Nullos denique per deos deasque

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.4
passages.text: Iurat Gellia, sed per uniones.

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.5
passages.text: Hos amplectitur, hos perosculatur,

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.6
passages.text: Hos fratres vocat, hos vocat sorores,

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.7
passages.text: Hos natis amat acrius duobus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.8
passages.text: His si quo careat misella casu,

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.9
passages.text: Victuram negat esse se nec horam.

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.10
passages.text: Eheu, quam bene nunc, Papiriane,

passages.label: Mart. 8.81.11
passages.text: Annaei faceret manus Sereni!

passages.label: Mart. 8.82.1
passages.text: Dante tibi turba querulos, Auguste, libellos,

passages.label: Mart. 8.82.2
passages.text: Nos quoque quod domino carmina parva damus,

passages.label: Mart. 8.82.3
passages.text: Posse deum rebus pariter Musisque vacare

passages.label: Mart. 8.82.4
passages.text: Scimus, et haec etiam serta placere tibi.

passages.label: Mart. 8.82.5
passages.text: Fer vates, Auguste, tuos: nos gloria dulcis,

passages.label: Mart. 8.82.6
passages.text: Nos tua cura prior deliciaeque sumus.

passages.label: Mart. 8.82.7
passages.text: Non quercus te sola decet nec laurea Phoebi:

passages.label: Mart. 8.82.8
passages.text: Fiat et ex hedera civica nostra tibi.
